_: BUG-332 / D-WS9-288 ruling 1b — public catalog meals whose centrepiece is a WHOLE or LARGE item, so the old house prompt could shrink the whole thing onto a dinner plate. Swept read-only on the dev copy of production (2026-09-27); 1,309 public meals scanned, 51 matched the word list, 35 survive hand-classification. Every one of the 35 is already `ready` with a bucket URL, so re-queuing them REPLACES a shared catalog image in the production bucket — hence §IMG (c) and its approval gate. `cookbook` is membership in kiwi-site/scripts/cookbook/state/_slugs.json at the time of the sweep.
